items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: I worked with him for around about six or seven years

ctx.x: Who were some of the drummers you liked to work with?

Well, drummers I worked with, most I worked with here was happy with Celestine man. I worked with him for around about six or seven years but George William I liked to work with him and this big fella here I can't think of his name now but he's a wonderful drummer man. He was at the home. He was an instructor back then with those kids back at the home. He's a good drummer.
What I was going to say Harrison is you still do quite a bit of that type of playing don't you? Staying at one key? Yeah,
